summary: One unified Laravel 11 app at the project root meets the design: GET / bootstraps all 7 groups from MySQL with the exact JS contracts (CARS array of 9 with 2-element accent and no desc key, CAT_STYLE object-not-array, QUIZ 4 questions/14 options with object-map scores, wheel short keeps \n, head + 13-script body order preserved), migrate:fresh --seed yields the exact row counts (cars=9, category_styles=4, quiz_questions=4, quiz_options=14, wheel_prizes=6, corner_images=3, hero_slides=4, testimonials=6, users=1), and /admin is auth-protected with registration fully disabled and full CRUD for all 7 groups with Indonesian labels and image/hex/rating validation. Build is green and php artisan test passes 47/47 (138 assertions); verified live by rendering GET / and querying MySQL directly.
